```yaml
name: Docs Preview Deploy
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs Preview PR"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: >
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == 'NVIDIA/NemoClaw'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download docs artifact
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const runId = context.payload.workflow_run.id;
            const artifacts = await github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRunArtifacts({
              owner,
              repo,
              run_id: runId
            });
            const artifact = artifacts.data.artifacts.find(a => a.name === 'docs-preview');
            if (!artifact) {
              throw new Error('No docs-preview artifact found');
            }
            const download = await github.rest.actions.downloadArtifact({
              owner,
              repo,
              artifact_id: artifact.id,
              archive_format: 'zip'
            });
            const fs = require('fs');
            fs.writeFileSync('docs-preview.zip', Buffer.from(download.data));
      - name: Extract and deploy docs
        run: |
          unzip docs-preview.zip -d docs-preview
          git clone --branch gh-pages https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw.git gh-pages
          cd gh-pages
          rm -rf pr-${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}/*
          cp -r ../docs-preview/* pr-${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}/
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Deploy docs preview for PR ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin gh-pages
      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -rf gh-pages docs-preview.zip docs-preview
```
